thesis: This run successfully opened long positions on three top picks from the Quality Matrix, leveraging strong composite scores and exceptional drilling results. Specifically, positions were opened on GR Silver Mining Ltd. (GRSL.V) and A2 Gold Corp. (AUAU.V). GR Silver Mining Ltd. was selected for its strong silver grade at 308 g/t (PAAS anchor) and moderate drill program type. A2 Gold Corp. was chosen for its exceptional gold grade at 93.3 g/t and moderate drill program type. The position on Marimaca Copper (MC2.AX) was not reopened due to a churn guard cooldown from a recent auto-rebalance.
